note: compat-rules-proof-1122 (docs/328 §5; started by probe-out/compat-wait-1122.sh after chain-sp-instantiate-guard-1122): in-game proof of the compatibility rules on 2-3 sample mods per rule group, in one queue; it also runs the compat-overlap-1122 set (jobs 8-9), so it replaces queue compat-overlap-1122. master set m1122 (ts3native 0.36.299-m1122 + ini + ts3fixes + agent, the sources the rule scan read), release defaults, Apex + bridge (Bin state apex via tools/turbo-compat.ts), save Baseline-IP. Build the sets first: node tools/mod-set.ts build docs/data/compat-rules-{base,nobase,core,own,old-debug,old-noshoo,old-consort}-1122.json and docs/data/compat-overlap-1122.json. Group R (docs/328 §7): runtime precedence build compat-resolve-1122. Groups: A compatible (override-calls-base, derives), B caveat (override-no-base, derives-hides), C module-current next to the test install's module-changed simler90 core (pair-core-other-module), overlap set, E own-issues, D module-old (incompatible). PASS per rule: A/B/C/overlap = the ON job loads the set, plays 10 min with 0 script errors and no crash or hang, judged against its OFF control (a script error that also shows with our mods OFF belongs to the mod); B also = the mod's own actions keep working (its caveat is only that our fix skips them). E = the OFF job reports the Builder Stuff error (REPORT line, counted apart): the flag is the mod's own. D = the OFF job fails (world load error, script errors or hang) with our mods OFF: the incompatibility is the old build's, not ours; these rows are expected FAIL and are judged by hand (docs/328 §5). D caveat: the test install's simler90 core also replaces Sims3GameplaySystems; if its copy wins, the old build never loads and the D job proves nothing (INCONCLUSIVE: rerun with simler90 moved out of the test Mods). Groups with no sample in our data stay static (named = NRaas in every run; key / tuning / asi / off-by-default: no row). Run: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/compat-rules-proof-1122.json --no-smoke (job 1 is the smoke). Est 13 jobs x 12-22 min, about 3.5-4 h.
